# StPageFlip (page-flip)

Used by مجلة الشهر (`wwwroot/js/magazine.js`) for the page-turn effect. Loaded locally, only when an issue opens; no network use.

- Package: `page-flip` 2.0.7 from npm (`dist/js/page-flip.browser.js`, unmodified), by Nodlik — https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
- npm integrity: `sha512-96lQFUUz7r/LZzEUZJ3yBIMEKU9+m8HMFDzTvTdD6P7Ag/wXINjp9n0W7b4wanwnDbQETo4uNUoL3zMqpFxwGA==`
- File SHA-256: `bbaca0bbef57a22bb66a3fc69d67baf9a17fb9a9c89ec9ed35e2b91abe4bd1e7`
- Licence: MIT, see `LICENSE` in this folder.
- The library has no right-to-left mode; `magazine.js` gives it the pages in reverse order so Arabic issues turn right-to-left.
